entities.summary: Gregory James Joly is a Canadian former ice hockey player who played nine seasons in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Washington Capitals and Detroit Red Wings. He won the 1974 Memorial Cup with the Regina Pats and the 1981 Calder Cup with the AHL's Adirondack Red Wings.
